board: Agent Groups I-L — Artifact Integrity, Versioning, Lineage

versioning.current_state: No artifact version field. Timestamp is the only temporal marker.
versioning.gap: Without artifactVersion, consumers cannot determine whether the artifact schema has changed. A schema-breaking change in readiness_scoring.json would silently break the Candidate Engine.
versioning.requirement: Add 'artifactVersion': '1.0.0' (semver) to all pipeline output artifacts.
versioning.upgrade_path: Consumers check artifactVersion before parsing. If major version differs → reject and request re-generation.

lineage.current_state: No parentArtifact or lineage chain. certification_candidates.json does not reference readiness_scoring.json as its data source.
lineage.gap: No way to trace whether certification_candidates.json was generated from the same pack-file state as readiness_scoring.json. Desynchronized artifacts (one generated Tuesday, the other Wednesday from different file versions) would produce unrecognizable inconsistencies.
lineage.requirement: Add 'parentArtifact': 'readiness_scoring.json::S322::2026-07-27T13:46:35Z' and 'sourceFileHashes': {pack_e: 'A98B27...'} to all downstream pipeline output.
lineage.tamper_evidence: Include a SHA-256 of the parent artifact's JSON content in the child artifact. Any change to the parent artifact after child generation is detectable.

per_item_hashes.delta_ledger: 3 hashes per item (contentHash, metadataHash, identityHash). SHA-256. GOOD.
per_item_hashes.readiness_scoring: No per-item hashes. Relies on QID+state+structural flags. ADEQUATE for scoring, but no content-integrity guarantees.
per_item_hashes.certification_candidates: No per-item hashes. Relies on QID+state+classification. ADEQUATE for certification pipeline, but no content-integrity guarantees.

cross_stage_integrity.gap: certification_candidates.json could be generated from entirely different pack files than readiness_scoring.json and no tool would detect the desynchronization.
cross_stage_integrity.requirement: certification_candidates.json must include the readiness_scoring.json's sourceFileHashes. Before consuming certification_candidates.json, the orchestrator verifies its embedded hashes match the current pack file hashes. Mismatch → re-scan.

verdict: INTEGRITY MODEL SPECIFIED. No current integrity violations detected in existing artifacts (all parse and cross-reference correctly in their current states). Gaps identified are future-state risks: (1) no artifact versioning, (2) no lineage chain, (3) no cross-stage desynchronization detection. Implementation scheduled for C2 (S819-S820).
